test_title: PYST 26: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north.

Only two people sit to the left of P. Only three people sit between P and W. Only one person sits between W and X. R sits to the immediate left of O. Y is not an immediate neighbour of W.

How many people sit to the right of Q?
solution:
Given: O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the left of P.

2) Only three people sit between P and W. 

3) Only one person sits between W and X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77a34fa69d62d2ac149ea3dbbcfbf3ae573e8ad0d25a221aee02016588dfbabe.png] 

4) R sits to the immediate left of O.

5) Y is not an immediate neighbour of W.

The remaining position will be occupied by the only person left i.e. Q. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c644fcb5158d049bd709bd069e4d8f6313a3bef3404d5c1c87b22ba9da6ed7e9.png] 

Thus, one person sit to the right of Q.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
